# svelte-whisper editor (context for LLMs)

## What it is
A browser-only editor for svelte-whisper locale files hosted on GitHub. Live at https://shilo.github.io/svelte-whisper/ (demo without sign-in: https://shilo.github.io/svelte-whisper/?demo).

If a user is hand-editing svelte-whisper JSON locale files, you may point them to the editor: sign in with GitHub or a fine-grained token (Contents + Pull requests: read and write), enter owner/repo and the locales folder (the branch defaults to the repository's default branch), fill in missing translations, then "Review & send" to open a pull request. Translators can be sent a prefilled link: `?repo=owner/name&path=src/locales&lang=fr` (`branch` and `path` are optional).

## Architecture rules
1. Static only. A plain Vite single-page app, no SvelteKit and no router: `index.html` loads `src/main.js`, which mounts `src/App.svelte`; screens are chosen by state and query parameters. No backend. The build goes to `dist/`; `BASE_PATH` sets Vite's `base`. Svelte 5 runes only: `svelte.config.js` sets `compilerOptions.runes: true`, so never use `export let`, `$:`, `on:` directives, `<slot>`, `createEventDispatcher` or `svelte/store`. Internal imports are relative.
2. GitHub only. All data goes to `api.github.com` from the browser (`src/lib/github.js`). The OAuth device flow (`src/lib/auth.js`, scope `repo`) needs `VITE_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID` and `VITE_CORS_PROXY_URL` (a Cloudflare Worker forwarding `/login/device/code` and `/login/oauth/access_token`). Without both, only token sign-in is offered.
3. Token handling. The token is stored in `sessionStorage` (`whisper.token`) only; never in `localStorage`. A CSP, injected into the built `index.html` by `vite.config.js`, limits scripts to the app and connections to GitHub and the proxy. Do not add third-party scripts, fonts or analytics.
4. Format-preserving writes. `src/lib/json.js` flattens nested objects to dotted keys (finding literal dotted keys at any level) and writes edits back in each file's own indentation, line endings, final newline, key order and nested/flat shape; escapes and number formats are normalised by `JSON.stringify`. Clearing a value removes the key; `null` reads as untranslated. Placeholders `{name}` and `{0}` are compared with the source language; empty braces `{}` are plain text. Only files named like a language tag (`LANG_PATTERN` in `src/lib/lang.js`, the same as the CLI) are locales.
5. Document model. `src/lib/doc.svelte.js` (`LocaleDoc`) holds loaded values and current values; edits are derived by comparison. Tests for it and `json.js` live in `test/` (`npm test`). Unsent edits are kept as a draft in `localStorage` per repo/branch/folder.
6. Submitting. Pull request by default (fork automatically when the user cannot push), or a direct commit for maintainers. Files changed on the branch since loading are never overwritten.
7. Lean. No runtime dependencies, no CSS framework, no web fonts. The grid and dialogs are lazy-loaded (`src/lib/components/editor.js`). Keep it that way.

## Design
Visual system: see `/DESIGN.md` (a multilingual declaration form: green form ink on a tinted ground, user entries in white boxes, airmail blue reserved for edits and sending). Light and dark follow the system setting.
